comparison.objective: Brake a coasting flywheel safely, remove its clamp nut and place the nut in a tray; candidate depins a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Remote braking, speed-state judgment and threaded nut removal versus wire deflection and blade-mediated latch release.
comparison.success_condition: Wheel stopped via lever, nut removed and placed, hands clear of moving rim; candidate requires selective extraction without damage. Candidate exact thresholds are absent.
comparison.reason: Safety sequencing around rotating machinery is meaningfully different.
